description: This file defines the ConnectionEventProducer interface which is used for producing connection events such as connect and disconnect notifications within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes nested interfaces for context management and references external classes like Device and DownstreamSenderFactory. The file is core to monitoring connection states, especially for protocol adapters supporting connection-oriented protocols like MQTT or AMQP.

classes.name: ConnectionEventProducer
classes.description: Interface for producing connection events (connect/disconnect) for monitoring and debugging purposes within the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: ConnectionEventProducer.Context
classes.description: Nested interface providing context for connection event production, specifically access to the message sender client.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Indicates a new connection has been established, returning a Future representing the result.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Indicates a connection has been closed, returning a Future representing the result.
